description: Scrape a website by following links and extracting relevant information based on natural language instructions

instruction.description: A natural language instruction specifying what information to find

js_handling.description: How to handle JavaScript-heavy pages: minimal (fastest), moderate (balanced), aggressive (most thorough)

max_links.description: Maximum number of links to follow per page (1-10)

max_pages.description: Maximum total number of pages to visit (1-20)

timeout_seconds.description: Maximum duration for the entire scraping process (30-300)

url.description: The starting URL for the scraping process

name: scrape-webpage
